summary: Industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring, yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels.
takeaways: During training, a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives.
Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels.
Although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge, they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation.
